# cloudsigma_current_usage (Data Source)

Reads the account's dynamic current usage and balance document as JSON.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity for the current usage document.
- `json` (String) The complete current usage document as canonical JSON.
